evals.name: Simple simulation end-to-end
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that opens an existing RoadRunner scenario called 'LeftTurnScenario' and runs the simulation with logging enabled. Wait for it to complete. Assume rrApp is already a connected roadrunner object.
assertions: Uses openScenario(rrApp, "LeftTurnScenario")
Uses simulateScenario(rrApp, EnableLogging=true)
No drivingScenario or roadrunnerScenario hallucination
Clean simple approach (not over-engineered with createSimulation)

evals.name: Step through a simulation
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that creates a step-by-step simulation of the current RoadRunner scenario. Configure it with a step size of 0.01s, enable logging, step through 100 iterations, then stop and retrieve the simulation log. Assume rrApp is already a connected roadrunner object.
assertions: Calls createSimulation(rrApp) BEFORE simulateScenario — server rejects connections while sim is running
Uses simulateScenario(rrApp, IsSteppingStart=true, IsBlocking=false) to start in stepping mode
Uses set(rrSim, SimulationCommand="Step") in loop not rrSim.step()
Includes pause(stepSize) after each Step command — Step is async and drops commands without it
Uses set(rrSim, SimulationCommand="Stop") not rrSim.stop()
Uses simulateScenario with IsSteppingStart=true to begin — does not call set(rrSim, SimulationCommand="Start") as a separate command
Uses get(rrSim, "SimulationLog") to retrieve log

evals.name: Get actor poses during simulation
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that during a running RoadRunner step-by-step simulation, gets all actors, finds the one with ID 1, and reads its current pose and velocity at each step for 50 steps. Store results in arrays. Assume rrApp is already a connected roadrunner object and rrSim = createSimulation(rrApp) has been called.
assertions: Uses get(rrSim, "ActorSimulation") or Simulink.ScenarioSimulation.find("ActorSimulation",...) — not get(rrSim, "Actors")
Uses getAttribute(actorSim, "Pose") not actorSim.Pose
Uses getAttribute(actorSim, "Velocity") not actorSim.Velocity
Uses Simulink.ScenarioSimulation.find with uint64 ActorID or iterates cell array
Uses set(rrSim, SimulationCommand="Step") for stepping

evals.name: Co-simulation actor control (MATLAB System object)
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB System object class that controls a vehicle actor in a RoadRunner co-simulation. Each step, it should read the current action assigned to the actor, set a new pose that moves the actor 0.5m forward in the x-direction, and signal action completion.
assertions: Uses Simulink.ScenarioSimulation.find("ActorSimulation", SystemObject=obj) in setupImpl
Uses getAction(actorSim, "PathAction") to read actions
Uses getAttribute(actorSim, "Pose") not actorSim.Pose
Uses setAttribute(actorSim, Pose=...) to set pose
Uses sendEvent(actorSim, "ActionComplete", actionID) to signal completion

evals.name: Add an observer to monitor simulation
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that adds a read-only observer to a RoadRunner scenario simulation. The observer should monitor all actor velocities and print them each step. Also write the observer System object class. Assume rrApp is already connected.
assertions: Uses addObserver(rrSim, name, fileName) to register observer
Observer class extends matlab.System
Observer setupImpl uses Simulink.ScenarioSimulation.find("ScenarioSimulation") not "ActorSimulation"
Observer uses getAttribute to read data (read-only — no setAttribute)
No hallucinated callback or listener pattern

evals.name: Attach sensors and read data during simulation
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that attaches a vision detection sensor to the ego vehicle (actor ID 1) in a RoadRunner scenario simulation, then steps through 50 iterations reading target poses and lane boundaries at each step. Assume rrApp is already connected.
assertions: Gets SensorSimulation via get(rrSim, "SensorSimulation")
Uses visionDetectionGenerator with SensorIndex parameter
Uses addSensors(sensorSim, sensor, actorID) on SensorSimulation object
Uses targetPoses(sensorSim, sensorID) to get targets
Uses laneBoundaries(sensorSim, sensorID) to get lanes
Does NOT call addSensors on rrSim or rrApp directly

evals.name: Simulink co-simulation setup
evals.prompt: Explain how to set up a Simulink model for RoadRunner scenario co-simulation. Write the MATLAB commands to publish the behavior and start the co-simulation. The model is called 'EgoVehicleModel'.
assertions: Mentions RoadRunner Scenario block at root level
Mentions RoadRunner Scenario Reader and Writer blocks
Uses Simulink.publish.publishActorBehavior for publishing
Uses set_param(model, SimulationCommand="start") NOT sim(model)
States that behavior assignment is done in RoadRunner UI
No hallucinated setBehavior or assignBehavior function

evals.name: Sensor on wrong object trap
evals.prompt: Write a MATLAB script that adds a radar sensor to the ego vehicle in a RoadRunner simulation and reads detections at each step. Assume rrApp is already connected and rrSim = createSimulation(rrApp) has been called.
assertions: Gets SensorSimulation via get(rrSim, "SensorSimulation") not constructed directly
Uses drivingRadarDataGenerator (correct constructor name)
Calls addSensors on sensorSim object, not rrSim
Calls targetPoses on sensorSim object, not rrSim
Each sensor has unique SensorIndex
